card.name: Information in 'Full Prescribing Information'
card.fires_on: The word Information (or information) right after 'Full Prescribing' or 'full prescribing' in cross-references to the complete label, often before 'for complete boxed warning'.

modes.label: Boxed warning pointer
modes.description: Lowercase 'see full prescribing information' directing readers to the complete boxed warning in the highlights section.
modes.example: See full prescribing<< information>> for complete boxed warning. • Increased risk

modes.label: Review or consult pointer
modes.description: Capitalized 'Full Prescribing Information' after Review or Consult, pointing to dosing or interaction details.
modes.example: Review the Full Prescribing<< Information>> for axitinib prior to initiation.

card.writes: Little clear effect; it mildly promotes 'or' and 'either' type words and suppresses odd code-like tokens.
card.plain: It marks the word 'Information' that completes the phrase 'Full Prescribing Information' when a label points readers to the full label.
